'''Tun Bohoi''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] Renunciate and a [[Legions of Lettow|Legionnaire]] of [[Lettow]], one of the many followers of [[Xendor]] during the [[First Great Schism]].

==Biography==
A [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]], Tun Bohoi lived on [[Ossus/Legends|Ossus]], the home of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] during its early years. During his time there, Bohoi became enamored by the enigmatic teachings of [[Xendor]], who preached that the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]] was too restrictive in their teachings and wished to limit understanding of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]]. When Xendor parted with the Order to found an [[Legionnaire Academy|academy]] on [[Lettow]], Bohoi followed to learn from Xendor. Calling themselves the [[Legions of Lettow]], the Jedi Renunciates grew strong in the Force as they studied the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|Bogan]] through many different Force-traditions.<ref name="EGW" />

When the High Council declared war on the Legions of Lettow, Bohoi and his fellows took up [[Force-imbued sword/Legends|swords]] to protect their rights to study the Force. Meeting the Order in a full-blown conflict called the [[First Great Schism|Great Schism]] by the Order, Bohoi jumped from world to world to fight off the Jedi as part of General Xendor's vanguard. At the [[Battle of Columus|battle]] of [[Columus/Legends|Columus]], the van was cut off from the bulk of the army by [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Awdrysta Pina]] and his Jedi Knights. Despite Bohoi's repute as a fine warrior, he fell alongside fellow Legionnaires Xendor and [[Sethul Asaiage]].<ref name="EGW" />
